title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: standardized papers 001-014p020, 081-090, and correspondence readers
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [#######---] active touched-paper stream: working paper-level translations and French source layers are present for selected Deligne papers, including a sequential source-checked block for papers 001-013 complete and paper 014 through page 20; [########--] correspondence stream: Deligne letters and letter sections are available in English with paired French working PDFs where supplied; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Added a source-checked sequential Deligne paper block for papers 001-013 complete plus paper 014 through page 20, with individual reader PDFs for papers 007-014 and a compact TeX/scan/QA source packet. Redundant Deligne-to-Manin section fragments were retired from the top-level reader list in favor of the cumulative sections 1 through 5 reader.
notes: Latest update adds Deligne papers 007-013 complete, paper 014 through page 20, and a sequential source packet for papers 001-014p020; redundant Manin section fragments are superseded by the cumulative sections 1 through 5 reader.
